name: @aeterna/server
description: Aeterna M6-M7 server: authoritative rooms over the engine port (packages/engine/headless.mjs loadEngine, one node:vm context per room), the store contract over Postgres, magic-link + Discord login, and the HTTP API. The pure parts (rooms, views, host, store) import no packages; ws (rooms) and pg (Postgres) are the server's runtime dependencies and install only when the image is built or the server runs - the offline single file never needs them.
